name: adhdme-site
description: ADHDme marketing site — static HTML with Tailwind CDN

scripts.build:css: npx -y tailwindcss@3.4.17 -c tailwind.config.js -i assets/css/input.css -o assets/css/tailwind.css --minify && npx -y clean-css-cli -O1 -o assets/css/site.min.css assets/css/fonts.css site.css motion.css privacy.css assets/css/tailwind.css
scripts.build:js: npx -y terser site.js motion.js analytics.js privacy-consent.js --compress --mangle -o assets/js/site.min.js
scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
